owner.heading: Why Whitecloud exists
owner.bio: Doyle Pruett ran no-heat calls for a big outfit long enough to hate the commission sheet more than the cold crawl spaces. The person diagnosing your furnace shouldn't be paid extra to declare it dead. So he started Whitecloud: one crew, both seasons, and the price on paper before the panel comes off. Winter or summer doesn't matter to the mountains — it shouldn't matter to your living room either.

faq.a: Yes. No-heat and no-cool calls jump the line, plan members first. Call rather than use the form if the house is uncomfortable right now — the form is for scheduling, the phone is for today.

faq.q: How often does a system really need a tune-up?
faq.a: Twice a year — cooling in spring, heating in fall. Skipping years doesn't break anything immediately; it just means the first 100° week or the first freeze gets to pick when you find the problem.

faq.q: Repair or replace — how do you decide?
faq.a: Simple math, done in front of you: if a repair costs more than half of what a new system would, and the unit is past its expected years, we'll say replace. If a $220 part buys you three more winters, we'll say repair. You decide either way.

faq.q: Which brands do you work on?
faq.a: All of them. Furnaces and ACs are more alike than the badges suggest. If a part is genuinely unavailable for an old unit, we'll tell you before anything is taken apart.

faq.q: How long does a new install take?
faq.a: Most straight swaps are one day — comfortable morning to late afternoon. Add ductwork changes and it can stretch to two. You'll get the timeline with the quote, in writing.

systemMap.label: Furnace
systemMap.symptoms: Short-cycling, rattling, weak heat, a burner that won't stay lit.
systemMap.covers: Burner cleaning, blower and ignition test, heat-exchanger look, carbon-monoxide reading.

systemMap.label: Return filter
systemMap.symptoms: Dust on every shelf, indoor allergies, airflow that feels lazy.
systemMap.covers: Filter swap, return-plenum check, and a size recommendation you can buy anywhere.

systemMap.label: Water heater
systemMap.symptoms: Lukewarm showers, popping sounds from the tank, rusty tint in hot water.
systemMap.covers: Flush, element and valve test, temperature check and an honest age assessment.

systemMap.label: Ductwork
systemMap.symptoms: One room always hot, one always cold, whistling behind the walls.
systemMap.covers: Leak check, a sealing quote if it needs one, and balancing between rooms.

systemMap.label: Thermostat
systemMap.symptoms: Readings that don't match the room, schedules that won't stick, short-cycling.
systemMap.covers: Calibration, wiring check, smart-thermostat setup and a five-minute lesson.

systemMap.label: Attic insulation
systemMap.symptoms: Upstairs bakes in July, heating bills creep up every January.
systemMap.covers: Depth check, air-gap inspection, and a plain-numbers estimate if it's thin.

systemMap.label: AC condenser
systemMap.symptoms: Warm air from the vents, ice on the lines, a unit that hums but won't spin.
systemMap.covers: Coil cleaning, pressure check, capacitor and fan test, refrigerant-line inspection.
